intent: Follow a small river from the grassy bank, through shallows and reeds, to a wide sunlit pond. Expert redesign: dragonfly sluices and swinging reed weights.

sections.name: The grassy riverbank
sections.lesson: Hop over roots beside the stream. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The grassy riverbank
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: Stepping-stone shallows
sections.lesson: Short hops and longer gaps alternate. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
Stepping-stone shallows
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The reed marsh
sections.lesson: The dry route winds above and below the reeds. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The reed marsh
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The broad river
sections.lesson: Board the skiff · step off at the far landing. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The broad river
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The sunny pond
sections.lesson: Bellflowers carry you over the last lily pools. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The sunny pond
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

secret_areas.name: The hidden potting room
secret_areas.hint: A gap beneath the ivy leads back into the hedge.

difficulty.verification_profile: default movement and charge dash, horizontal 1.5, unassisted
